biochemCosting.title: Biochem product costing
biochemCosting.subtitle: Cost of one saleable pack per batch, from the consumption ledger and the rates Admin sets · fixed when the batch closes
biochemCosting.noCostRight: Costs are hidden — you need the "See cost and margin" right. Ask Admin.
biochemCosting.emptyBody: A cost sheet appears once a batch has started using materials; it is fixed when the batch closes.
biochemCosting.missingTitle: {{n}} batch(es) were costed with a missing rate (counted as zero)
biochemCosting.missingNext: Admin sets the missing rates below; batches closed later use them. A closed batch keeps the cost it was closed with.
biochemCosting.ratesMissing: Missing rates (counted as zero): {{list}}. Admin sets them on Biochem costing.

how.title: How one pack is costed
how.formula: (materials + packaging + labour hours × rate + machine hours × rate + overhead per kg × bulk) ÷ good packs

materials.title: Materials
materials.body: each checked weighing at the lot's rate, from the consumption ledger.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.body: used in packs plus scrapped at the line, at lot rates.

labour.title: Labour and machine
labour.body: hours recorded on the batch × the rate in force on the batch date.

overhead.title: Overhead
overhead.body: per kg of bulk made, at the rate Admin sets; absorption into stock value is a CA decision.

rates.title: Cost rates
rates.emptyBody: Until Admin sets the rates, labour, machine and overhead count as zero and every cost sheet lists them as missing.
rates.hint: Enter the rate as a number (zero or more).
